# Good doc

This doc describes the current state of the repo with clean prose.

The API version header is a stable literal: `X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2022-11-28`.

An anchor link such as [delete the tag](contributing.md#1-delete-the-tag) is
fine because the date-looking digits sit behind a `-` boundary.

Hex colors like #fff and HTML entities like \&#123; are not issue refs.
